activity.notes: Representative year 1544 is a person-specific documentary anchor: the Taiwan Ministry of Education biographical entry states that Wu Cheng'en became a tribute student (gongsheng) in Jiajing 23 (1544). ATLAS does not use a disputed exact composition date of Journey to the West as his chronology anchor.
